purpose: Modal surface that interrupts the flow for a focused decision - above all, confirmation of destructive or costly actions.

variants.name: confirm
variants.usage: Yes/no decision with an explicit consequence statement.

variants.name: destructive-confirm
variants.usage: Confirmation for destructive actions; confirm button uses the danger variant and the safe action is the default focus.

props.name: id
props.description: Target id referenced by open-dialog actions.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog heading; labels the dialog for AT.

accessibility.requirement: Dialog is labelled by its title (aria-labelledby) and uses role=dialog with aria-modal.
Focus moves into the dialog on open, is trapped while open, and returns to the trigger on close.
Escape closes the dialog without committing the action.

constraints.rule: Every dialog offers a non-destructive exit (cancel button).
destructive-confirm dialogs state the consequence in body text and use a danger confirm button.

children.content: You will lose access to Pro features at the end of the billing period. This cannot be undone.
